lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately four distinct vertical columns and five horizontal rows posterior to the fifth gill slit, forming a regular geometric grid.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Broad vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs to create a series of high-contrast anchor nodes on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal features running longitudinally across the upper flank, marked by a sharp vertical luminance transition with high-intensity upper surfaces and shadowed lower margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense, high-frequency clustering of small high-luminance spots across the entire visible surface of the primary pectoral fin.
